package.name: FpgaDevices
package.doc: FPGA devices and their resources. Each device family defines the resources its devices have and blocks use up (an attribute def specializing FpgaResources); each device gives its capacity as values of its family's resources. A block's estimate is a value of the same def, so estimates and capacity add up and compare type by type. Families are not converted into one another.

attributeDefs.name: FpgaResources
attributeDefs.doc: The resources a design uses up, counted; each device family specializes this with its own resource types.

attributeDefs.name: FpgaDevice
attributeDefs.doc: An FPGA device: its family, and its capacity in that family's resources.

attributeDefs.name: FpgaResourceMargins
attributeDefs.doc: The share of each resource to keep free, in percent: a design is over its budget when it uses more than (100 - margin)% of the device. Each device family specializes this with its own resources.

attributeDefs.name: ZynqUltraScalePlusMargins
attributeDefs.doc: AMD Zynq UltraScale+ resource margins, in percent; the defaults apply unless a design gives its own.

attributeDefs.name: XCZU9EG
attributeDefs.doc: AMD Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU9EG (the ZCU102 board's device). Capacity from AMD DS891, Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC Data Sheet: Overview.
